punchline: Dodge stopped running and lit a fire of his own.
thirty_sec: On 5 August 1949 a blow-up swept Mann Gulch in Montana and covered about 3,000 acres in ten minutes. Foreman Wagner Dodge dropped the plan to outrun it, lit an escape fire and lay down in the burnt ground. Thirteen men died; Dodge, Sallee and Rumsey survived.
question: Which routine are you running harder although the situation has already changed?
key_contrast: Running faster versus asking what the fire needs.
